cases.input: Person P has legal employment with A and B and WM-ORG-016 assignment allocated supply FTE of 0.6 and 0.5.
cases.expect: Unique persons is 1, active legal relationships 2, employer legal headcount is 1 for each employer, consolidated distinct employed persons is 1 and assignment allocated supply FTE is 1.1.

cases.input: Agency worker P has agency employment and a host assignment.
cases.expect: Host assignment and allocated FTE may count while host legal headcount remains unchanged.

cases.input: An established position is vacant at the reporting instant.
cases.expect: Position and demand-side FTE may count; no person, relationship or assignment is created.

cases.input: A small cross-tab would identify a unique dual-affiliation pattern.
cases.expect: The released figure carries suppression under its disclosure profile without converting the value to zero.

cases.input: Two employment relationships are counted as two unique people.
cases.expect: The count is rejected because unique persons resolve WM-PER-001 anchors.

cases.input: A contractor assignment is treated as host employment and host legal headcount.
An active badge is used to infer active employment status.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected because active status must be asserted by its master.

cases.input: Assignment allocated FTE and position authorized FTE are coalesced into one unnamed FTE total.
cases.expect: The result is rejected; each FTE class names its source and different classes remain separate.

cases.input: A release reports person-available and position-authorized capacity for the same unit.
cases.expect: Both figures remain separately named with their own denominator, period and source pins.

cases.input: One person has two legal employments within a consolidated perimeter.
cases.expect: Employer legal headcount is 1 for each employer and consolidated distinct employed persons is 1; the canonical measure names remain distinct.

cases.input: A view is generated without the pinned WM-ORG-016 revision used for assignment FTE.
cases.expect: Generation fails closed rather than reading the current assignment state.

cases.input: A population predicate changes while all source facts remain unchanged.
cases.expect: A new Workforce Scope revision and Landscape fingerprint are produced; the prior artifacts remain immutable.

cases.input: A payroll or employment record uses a Workforce Scope id or Landscape fingerprint as its person or employment key.
cases.expect: The reference is rejected; artifact identifiers support citation and replay only.

cases.input: Two otherwise safe releases reveal one joiner through their delta.
cases.expect: The pinned disclosure policy suppresses or aggregates the result according to release-set linkability rules.

cases.input: A consolidated distinct-employed-person count reads A and B while its pinned access scope authorizes only A.
cases.expect: The consolidated measure fails closed because every contributing employer must be authorized.

cases.input: A point-in-time headcount and period-average FTE are placed in one cross-tab without a reconciliation rule.
cases.expect: The combined result is rejected because release-level temporal comparability is undefined.

cases.input: A contractor has a resolved WM-PER-001 anchor and the Scope explicitly includes the contractor assignment class.
cases.expect: The contractor may count once in unique persons and assignments but never in host employer legal headcount.
